messages:
erin: PR #10321 updates the SDK migration guide (v1->v2). CI preview shows a broken external link and one example that still has a token-like placeholder. We need security + legal quick thumbs before merge.

ci-bot: Docs preview for PR 10321: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/10321 — build: passed, link-check: failed (1 broken external link). Files changed: docs/sdk/migration-v2.md

matt: I'll push a tiny cleanup branch to replace the token and fix the link. Quick question: demonstrate secret manager or env var? From a DX POV showing both in one compact snippet is helpful.

security: Please do not include anything that looks like a real token. Create a redaction ticket for tracking — sec-240 created. Policy: use PLACEHOLDER_SECRET or SecretManager access pattern.

erin: Original snippet (bad):
```js
// BAD - looks like a key
const token = "live_sk_9z8y7x6w5v4";
```

erin: Proposed replacement (in branch 10321-fix):
```js
// GOOD - show env and secret manager patterns
const tokenEnv = process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN; // CI injects this
const tokenSecret = await secretManager.access('projects/x/secrets/REDWOOD_API_TOKEN/versions/latest');
```

legal: Quick check: avoid realistic prefixes like live_sk_. Replace with GENERIC_TOKEN if you need an example string. No legal blocking issues otherwise.

matt: I fixed the external link (it pointed to an outdated blog). Updated to the public spec link. Pushed the cleanup.

ci-bot: Preview updated: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/10321 — build: succeeded, link-check: passed.

security: Reviewed the updated snippets and confirm sec-240 can be closed after merge. Recommend adding a contributor-guide pointer about placeholder conventions.

legal: Approve from legal side.

erin: Planning to merge in the docs merge window at 11:00–11:30am PT. I'll merge at ~11:05am PT unless someone asks to delay.

matt: Fine with that. I'll monitor the merge. :rocket:

devx-bot: Noted — contributor guide updated with placeholder examples in PR #10345.

erin: Merged at 11:06am PT. Closing sec-240 and filing a small follow-up to add a short checklist to the migration guide for secret-handling. Thanks team!
